title: Subgraph Reconstruction Attacks on Graph RAG Deployments with Practical Defenses
authors: Minkyoo Song; Jaehan Kim; Myungchul Kang; Hanna Kim; Seungwon Shin; Sooel Son
why_relevant: Proposes a subgraph reconstruction attack against Graph RAG and evaluates defenses, contributing to the adversarial corruption/extraction threat landscape in RAG.
why_not_or_caveat: Focus is on privacy extraction rather than poisoning/injection or evidence reliability; tangential to core robustness themes.
